# Microsoft Teams

Microsoft Teams integrates chat, video meetings, and file storage within Microsoft 365, providing virtual collaboration and communication for distributed teams

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/microsoft-teams/.

## Actions

- **Add member to team**: Add a user to a microsoft teams team.
- **Archive Teams team**: Archive a microsoft teams team.
- **Create Chat**: Creates a new chat.
- **Create online meeting**: Schedule a new standalone microsoft teams online meeting, i.e., one not linked to any calendar event.
- **Create Team**: Create a new microsoft teams team.
- **Delete Teams team**: Delete a microsoft teams team.
- **Get chat message** (read-only): Get a specific chat message.
- **Get Team** (read-only): Get a specific team.
- **Get team channel** (read-only): Get a specific channel in a team.
- **List message replies** (read-only): List replies to a channel message.
- **List team members** (read-only): List members of a microsoft teams team.
- **Unarchive Teams team**: Unarchive a microsoft teams team.
- **Update Team**: Update the properties of a team.
- **Update Teams channel message**: Update a message in a channel.
- **Update Teams chat message**: Update a specific message in a chat.
- **Create a channel**: Creates a new 'standard', 'private', or 'shared' channel within a specified microsoft teams team.
- **Get all chat messages** (read-only): Retrieves all messages from a specified microsoft teams chat using the microsoft graph api, automatically handling pagination.
- **Get all chats** (read-only): Retrieves all microsoft teams chats a specified user is part of, supporting filtering, property selection, and pagination.
- **Get Teams message** (read-only): Retrieves a specific message from a microsoft teams channel using its team, channel, and message ids.
- **List chat messages** (read-only): Retrieves messages (newest first) from an existing and accessible microsoft teams one-on-one chat, group chat, or channel thread,…
- **List People** (read-only): Retrieves a list of people relevant to a specified user from microsoft graph, noting the search parameter is only effective if user id is…
- **List team channels** (read-only): Retrieves channels for a specified microsoft teams team id (must be valid and for an existing team), with options to include shared…
- **List Teams** (read-only): Retrieves microsoft teams accessible by the authenticated user, allowing filtering, property selection, and pagination.
- **List Teams templates** (read-only): List available microsoft teams templates.
- **List users** (read-only): List all users in the organization.
- **Post message to Teams channel**: Posts a new text or html message to a specified channel in a microsoft teams team.
- **Reply to Teams channel message**: Sends a reply to an existing message, identified by message id, within a specific channel id of a given team id in microsoft teams.
- **Send message to Teams chat**: Sends a non-empty message (text or html) to a specified, existing microsoft teams chat.
